seed-calendar-planner v1.0.0

- Initial release providing personalized seed-starting and planting calendars for vegetable gardens based on local frost dates and crop selection.
- Generates dated action lists for indoor seed starting, outdoor sowings, transplants, fall planting deadlines, and succession schedules.
- Calculates tray/cell requirements and row-footage estimates from household size and crop list.
- Includes machine-readable output, moon-phase annotations, and flexible command-line interface.
- Designed for frost-driven annual vegetable gardens; not suitable for indoor-only, year-round greenhouse, or permaculture systems.
